lessons.task: Give visual direction for a premium dog training landing page.
lessons.what_worked: Provided a detailed and creative visual direction for the dog training landing page.
lessons.what_failed: The response did not include specific design elements or visual assets, which are crucial for a comprehensive brief.
lessons.improvement: Include sketches or mockups to visually represent the proposed design directions.
lessons.root_cause: Focused too much on descriptive text and overlooked the importance of visual aids in creative tasks.
